game_start.intro: The game begins. Trump suit: {trump_suit} (trump card: {trump_str}).
game_start.no_trump_card: ki muala kima kia difu ni kiki.

player_prompt.intro:
You are Player {player_id} in German Whist.
{phase_info}
You hold {hand_size} cards.
Play a card with '[play N]', where N is its position in your hand (for example '[play 3]').
player_prompt.phase_learning: LEARNING PHASE: the winner of each trick takes the face-up card and the loser draws the next card from the deck. Tricks won in this phase do not count towards victory.
player_prompt.phase_playing: PLAYING PHASE: the deck is exhausted. Every trick from now on counts towards victory.

next_card.playing_phase: No card is on offer - the playing phase has begun.
next_card.deck_empty: The deck is empty - no card is on offer.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Invalid move format. Use '[play N]' to play the Nth card in your hand.
invalid_move.bad_position: That card position does not exist. You hold {hand_size} cards.
invalid_move.must_follow_suit: Unapaswa kufuata nlundo na cheza kajila ya {lead_suit}.
invalid_move.invalid_play: O kitambuijilu kiki ki tena ku kala kia kidi.

game_action.played: O muadikime {player_id} u jokala o mbandu ia 1 {card}.

trick.won_learning: Player {winner_id} wins the trick with {card} and takes the face-up card.

phase.learning_complete: The deck is exhausted. The learning phase is over - every remaining trick counts towards victory.

draw.winner_received: Eie ua nganhala o kikoué, eie u tambula {card}.
draw.loser_received: You lost the trick and drew {card} from the deck.

turn.scores_learning: Tricks won so far - Player 0: {tricks0}, Player 1: {tricks1}
turn.phase_learning: Phase: {phase} ({remaining_cards} cards left in the deck)

hand.no_cards_in_hand: Ki ngala ni kalatá ka salu bhu maku'ami.

trick_view.empty: No cards played yet this trick.

board_str.blank: {observation} O ku di longa o Bibidia.

outcome.summary: Learning phase - Player 0: {l0}, Player 1: {l1}. Playing phase - Player 0: {p0}, Player 1: {p1}. Player {winner_id} wins with {winner_tricks} scoring tricks!
